about_the_game:
Introducing Spray Forge - the ultimate spray pattern reference tool that transforms your training setup. This small always-on-top window sits perfectly on your second monitor, giving you instant access to spray patterns without alt-tabbing or opening browsers. Simply use hotkeys to switch between weapon patterns even while in-game, keeping your focus where it matters most.

More than just a static reference guide - Spray Forge functions like a lightweight drawing application that tracks your mouse movements and overlays them directly onto the spray pattern images. Watch in real-time as your mouse movements align with the ideal spray pattern, building perfect muscle memory through visual feedback.

Simple desktop application - this tool works entirely as a standard Windows application, reading mouse input the same way any drawing program or productivity software does. It operates independently from games, requiring no modifications or special integrations. Think of it as an enhanced version of having spray pattern images open in a browser tab.

Train on your schedule - whether you're actively playing, in practice mode, or simply training without any game running, Spray Forge provides consistent pattern practice. It's a straightforward training aid that adapts to however you prefer to improve your aim.

Build better spray control with a tool designed for convenience and effectiveness.
